title: Find the Difference of Two Arrays
description: Find distinct integers in nums1 not in nums2 and vice versa.
pseudocode:
1. s1 = set(nums1), s2 = set(nums2)
2. res1 = [x for x in s1 if x not in s2]
3. res2 = [x for x in s2 if x not in s1]
4. return [res1, res2]

steps.note: Convert nums1 and nums2 to sets to get distinct elements.
Calculate elements in set1 not in set2: {1, 2, 3} - {2, 4, 6} = {1, 3}.
Calculate elements in set2 not in set1: {2, 4, 6} - {1, 2, 3} = {4, 6}.
